bio: Frederic Scavone made a name for himself at Le Pontecino in Liège, before setting up shop in this impressive edifice, flanked by a modern wing. His contemporary spin on Italian cooking does feature the occasional Gallic twang, but Mediterranean exuberance is probably its overriding characteristic. Rigatoni alla norma, homemade ravioli with fresh sausages and a personal interpretation of tiramisu… Flavour is the watchword of Linéa. Book a room and treat yourself to a truly relaxing weekend in style....
